name: snake-eats-rabbits
description: Snake Eats Rabbits — HTML5 Canvas game with TypeScript

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:server && node scripts/run-development.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:server && webpack --mode production
scripts.build:debug: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:server && webpack --mode production --env noMinify
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.start:server: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:server && node apps/server/dist/index.js
